versions.changelog:
coding-delegate-agent v1.0.0

- Initial release of the coding-agent skill.
- Enables delegation of coding tasks to Codex, Claude Code, Pi, or OpenCode via background processes.
- Provides detailed guidance for agent selection, PTY requirements, and safe workspace usage.
- Supports interactive session management: start, monitor, log, write, kill, etc.
- Includes usage patterns for building features, PR review, refactoring, and parallel workflows.
- Outlines best practices for isolation, safety (e.g., temp dirs, worktrees), and supported shell command patterns.
